# TASK-024 Invoice numbers

Status: ready

Outcome: invoices are numbered the way the ruling cited below says. Summary from the planning agent: invoice numbers carry the shop's prefix, for example SHOP-0001.

## Ruling reference

Handed over by the planning agent.

Reference
  Binding        billing
  Repository     example/mira-billing
  ADR            0005
  Path           docs/adr/0005-invoice-numbering.md
  Commit         3f1c9b7a2d4e8f605a1b3c7d9e0f2a4b6c8d1e3f
  Digest         sha256:5d41402abc4b2a76b9719d911017c5925d41402abc4b2a76b9719d911017c592

## Blocker (agent note, 2026-10-22)

Not started. The cited ruling (example/mira-billing, ADR 0005, commit 3f1c9b7a2d4e8f605a1b3c7d9e0f2a4b6c8d1e3f) could not be read: that repository is not available locally, so its digest and in-force status are unverified. The task only has the planning agent's summary (prefix such as SHOP-0001).
Note: `../mira-decisions` has a different ADR 0005 (shops-pay-by-bank-transfer-not-card), which is unrelated to invoice numbering and was not used.
Needed before building: access to example/mira-billing at the cited commit, confirm the digest matches and the ADR is still in force (not superseded).
